name: Julija Simpson
bio:
Dr Julija Simpson PhD is a health economist whose research examines how social and economic policies shape population health and health inequalities, with a particular focus on social security systems and mental health. 
Julija uses advanced quantitative methods, including longitudinal data analysis, causal inference approaches and systematic reviews, to evaluate the health impacts of public policy. She has led several peer-reviewed publications and a Health Equity North policy report on the economic consequences of regional health inequalities, launched in Parliament. Her research has featured in national and regional media and has informed parliamentary debates on welfare reform and health-related economic inactivity.
